objective: Build a source-only panel-response atlas that predicts, for each of the 300 VCC targets, effects on the other 299 VCC-panel genes while leaving every non-panel coordinate and every target-self coordinate exactly zero.

axes.target_rows: data/challenge/pert_counts.csv target_gene in canonical file order
axes.response_columns: the same 300 target_gene symbols in the same order
axes.mapping: exact UTF-8 gene symbol only; no aliases or case folding
axes.non_panel: exact zero in the expanded 300 by 18533 artifact

k562_gwps.effect: existing compact delta.npy in log1p TS50000 pseudobulk coordinates
k562_gwps.valid: exact target and response symbols present in compact axes

orion_hct116.effect: existing compact delta.npy in log1p TS50000 pseudobulk coordinates
orion_hct116.valid: exact target and response symbols present in compact axes

orion_hek293t.effect: existing compact delta.npy in log1p TS50000 pseudobulk coordinates
orion_hek293t.valid: exact target and response symbols present in compact axes

cd4_conditions.effect: existing compact delta.npy, defined as ln(2) times source DESeq2 log2 fold change
cd4_conditions.target_qc: ontarget_significant true, neighboring_gene_KD false, distal_offtarget_flag false, low_target_gex false, n_guides at least 2

correlated_source_grouping.orion: HCT116 and HEK293T are collapsed coordinate-wise before cross-family modeling and count as one family
correlated_source_grouping.cd4: Rest, Stim8hr, and Stim48hr are collapsed coordinate-wise before cross-family modeling and count as one family
correlated_source_grouping.family_weights: equal across replogle_k562, orion, and cd4

row_scale_normalization.definition: for each family and target row, median absolute nonzero valid off-diagonal panel effect
row_scale_normalization.fallback: row invalid when the scale is nonfinite or nonpositive
row_scale_normalization.consensus_space: divide each valid family row by its row scale
row_scale_normalization.output_rescaling: multiply consensus by the median row scale of contributing families

candidate_family.name: equal_mean_magnitude
candidate_family.location: arithmetic mean of normalized family effects

candidate_family.name: equal_mean_agreement
candidate_family.location: arithmetic mean of normalized family effects
candidate_family.confidence: absolute normalized consensus magnitude times family-support fraction times absolute mean nonzero sign

candidate_family.name: equal_median_agreement
candidate_family.confidence: absolute normalized consensus magnitude times family-support fraction times absolute mean nonzero sign

candidate_family.name: sign_consensus_median_min2
candidate_family.location: median of normalized effects only where at least two families are valid and a strict nonzero sign majority exists; otherwise zero
candidate_family.confidence: absolute normalized consensus magnitude times family-support fraction times absolute mean nonzero sign

primary_validation.training: build each candidate from the other two family aggregates only
primary_validation.target_evaluable: held target row valid, at least one training family carries the target, and at least 20 held response coordinates are valid
primary_validation.signed_credit_per_target: sum(sign(held_effect) times predicted_effect) divided by sum(abs(held_effect)) over all held-valid off-diagonal panel coordinates
primary_validation.top20_sign_precision_per_target: select ceil(0.20 times held-valid response count) coordinates by descending confidence with canonical column order as tie break; zero predicted sign is incorrect; weight correctness by abs(held_effect)
primary_validation.aggregation: arithmetic mean over targets within family, then conservative minimum over the three held families
selection_order: larger worst-family top20 weighted sign precision
larger macro top20 weighted sign precision
earlier candidate order in this protocol
primary_validation.identity_policy: identity is the fallback and wins only if no nonidentity candidate passes every-family gates

target_label.assignment: one frozen 300-row derangement is applied coherently to every training family in each LOFO fold while held truth remains fixed
target_label.rerun: recompute every candidate, every family metric, eligibility, and final selection

response_label.assignment: one frozen 300-column derangement is applied coherently to effects and validity of every training family in each LOFO fold while held truth remains fixed
response_label.rerun: recompute every candidate, every family metric, eligibility, and final selection

complete_selection_nulls.gate: observed selected worst-family signed credit must be strictly above the p95 selected worst-family credit from both complete-selection null families
